question: According to the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) custody RFP, how much in assets did SBCERS have as of September 30, 2023?
gold_answer: Approximately $4.06 billion (the OPEB Plan separately had approximately $53 million).
acceptance: Approximately $4.06bn suffices; OPEB figure is optional and should not be added to the requested figure.
candidate_answer: According to the custody RFP, SBCERS had approximately **$4.06 billion** in assets as of September 30, 2023. The RFP lists the OPEB Plan separately at approximately $53 million. [Source: SBCERS custody RFP, p. 3](SBCERS__01_2023-SBCERS-Custody-RFP-CONSOLIDATED-Final-Updated.pdf)
